description: The compat suite's two-player stage (tools/compat/tacompat.py): the hosting peer's half, applied on that peer, where owner 0 is the local player. Thirty units meet the joining peer's (scenarios/compat-mp-join.json) on dry, level ground of Two Continents, at least WAVE_CLEAR (1500) world pixels from every start a record of the network game takes (tacompat.py, THE FIGHT STAYS OFF THE SEATS), so both peers send each other creates, moves and hits and no seat's commander is in the fight. Stock types: a mod that replaces them (TA Zero) names its own halves in the setup's `scenarios`. The commanders stay (clear_existing false).
